statements.t: Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA) Complete Response Letter (CRL), we continue to execute our plan to address the chemistry, manufacturing and controls (CMC) and non-clinical data items, and are making progress toward resubmission of our New Drug Application (NDA) for GTx-104,” said Prashant Kohli, Chief Executive Officer of Grace Therapeutics.
The financing concluded in August extends our expected cash runway through the end of calendar 2028, and positions us well as we work toward NDA resubmission.
We look forward to reporting our progress as we work toward achieving these important milestones.”
The Company plans to use its existing cash and cash equivalents towards resolving the items cited in the FDA’s CRL, working capital and other general corporate purposes.

The Company believes its existing cash and cash equivalents will be sufficient to sustain planned operations, including the activities to address the items cited in the CRL, through the end of calendar 2028.

risks.t: various risks and uncertainties, including, without limitation: (i) the timing and success of any regulatory resubmission of the NDA for GTx-104
(iv) the need to complete additional non-clinical studies
(v) the requirement that any resubmission comprehensively address all items cited in the CRL and the risk of review delay
(vi) the Company’s potential need for additional capital, which may not be available on acceptable terms
(viii) the Company’s ability to protect its intellectual property for GTx-104
(ix) legislative, regulatory, political and economic developments
